description.value: Beat. Patisserie is a small, independent, woman-run pastry shop in Lake Country founded by Mackenzie, a trained pastry chef who completed a semester abroad at a Michelin-starred restaurant in Reims, France. The shop focuses on French-inspired pastries, cakes, breads, and baked goods made with high-quality ingredients and local produce. A wide range of items — croissants, scones, muffins, cheesecake slices, and specialty cakes — can be ordered online for pickup or purchased in-store.

address.value: 101-11850 Oceola Road, Lake Country, BC V4V 2T5

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live (copyright 2026, active Shopify store with 50+ products in stock) confirming the business is open. Address (101-11850 Oceola Road, Lake Country, BC V4V 2T5) and phone (778-480-2944) are confirmed from multiple website pages. Online ordering with in-store pickup is explicitly described ('Items ordered online will be ready for pick up in 3 business days'). Gluten-free is confirmed via the wedding page ('Gluten free cake and tastings are available'). No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any other cyclist infrastructure anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM name is 'Beat Patisserie' but the business consistently styles itself 'Beat. Patisserie' (with a period after 'Beat') on its website. OSM name retained per rules; discrepancy noted.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible pastry shop in Lake Country with a live website, confirmed address, and a full product catalog — a natural stop for touring cyclists on the Okanagan Rail Trail corridor.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Gluten-free cakes and tastings explicitly offered ('Gluten free cake and tastings are available for an additional charge'). Many pastry items (cookies, muffins, scones, croissants) are likely vegetarian but this is not explicitly stated on the site
